name: Ayesha Khan
text: The royal velvet cake was soft, rich and beautifully decorated. It was the centrepiece of our family dinner.

name: Bilal Ahmed
text: Flaky, buttery layers and a perfect golden crust. The best croissant I have had in a long time.

name: Sara Malik
text: Lovely cupcakes with a smooth frosting. I would enjoy them slightly sweeter, but they looked gorgeous.

name: Hamza Raza
text: Crisp base, generous toppings and fast to customise. The extra cheese option was a great touch.

name: Fatima Noor
text: A smooth latte with lovely foam. A cosy place to sit with a book and a pastry.

name: Usman Tariq
text: Chewy centre and crisp edges. The chocolate chip cookies disappeared in minutes.

name: Mariam Siddiqui
text: The fruit tart was fresh and not overly sweet. The shell was perfectly crisp.

name: Zain Abbas
text: Excellent sourdough with a crackling crust. Great with soup on a cool evening.

name: Hira Yousuf
text: Soft donuts with fun toppings. The glaze was a little thin on mine, but the flavour was good.

name: Danish Qureshi
text: The Kashmiri pink tea was creamy and fragrant. A perfect companion to a warm pastry.

name: Noor Fatima
text: The signature mug is sturdy and looks elegant on my desk. A lovely gift idea.

name: Imran Sheikh
text: The chocolate fudge shake was thick, cold and indulgent. Easily my favourite drink on the menu.
